chunks: Al-Sakuni narrated from Abu Abdullah عليه السلام, who said:
The first thing to be taken care of from the wealth is the shroud, then the debt, then the will, then the inheritance.

key_terms.الدَّيْنُ: outstanding debt owed by the deceased
key_terms.الْكَفَنُ: the burial shroud taken from the deceased's estate
key_terms.الْمَالِ: the wealth or estate left by the deceased
key_terms.الْمِيرَاثُ: the inheritance distributed to the heirs
key_terms.الْوَصِيَّةُ: the bequest or will to be executed from the estate

ai.seo_question: What is the order of funeral expenses, debts, will, and inheritance in a deceased person's estate?
ai.summary: This hadith states the order in which the estate of a deceased person is to be handled. It establishes that the burial shroud is provided first from the estate, then debts are settled, then the will is carried out, and only after that is the inheritance distributed.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.5437 - Al-Sakuni narrated from Abu Abdullah (as), who said:
"The first thing to be taken care of from the wealth (of the deceased) is the shroud (for burial), then the debts, then the will, and then the inheritance."
